title: AdvManhunt
description:
The ultimate manhunt plugin with professional GUI, soulbound items, real-time tracking, and advanced game management!

Created by Prachan Subedi

🎮 Minecraft: stingplayer_
💬 Discord: stingplayer
body:
✨ Enhanced Features

🎮 Professional Game Management
Interactive GUI - Custom textured heads and professional design
Smart Scatter System - Speedrunner in center, hunters in 3-block circle
Advanced Soulbound - Any item can be made soulbound, not just armor
Real-time Tracking - Live distance display above experience bar
Pause/Resume System - Full game state management with visual effects
Server Reset - Complete reset for fresh manhunt games

⚔️ Enhanced Team System
Multiple Teams - Speedrunner, Hunters, Guards, Spectators
Easy Management - Simple commands for team assignment
Visual Feedback - Color-coded messages and status displays
Team Spawns - Custom spawn points for each team
Live Statistics - Real-time game duration and team info

🧭 Advanced Compass Features
Lodestone Tracking - Accurate pointing with lodestone compass
Distance Display - Exact distance shown above experience bar
Direction Indicators - Cardinal directions (N, NE, E, SE, etc.)
Cross-dimension - Works across overworld, nether, and end
Configurable Updates - Adjustable refresh intervals

🎯 Professional Controls
Hunter Boost - Speed and jump boost when headstart ends
Headstart Management - Configurable speedrunner advantage
Sound Effects - Professional audio feedback
Action Bar Updates - Non-intrusive status messages

🚀 Quick Start
Installation
Download EasyManhunt.jar
Place in your plugins/ folder
Restart server
Run /manhunt gui to start
Basic Setup
Set teams: /manhunt runner <player>, /manhunt hunter <player>
Configure settings in GUI or config.yml
Use /manhunt scatter to position players
Start with /manhunt start

📋 Complete Command List

Core Game Commands
Command	Description	Permission
/manhunt	Show all available commands	manhunt.admin
/manhunt help	Display command help menu	manhunt.admin
/manhunt start	Start the manhunt game	manhunt.admin
/manhunt stop	Stop current game	manhunt.admin
/manhunt gui	Open professional control panel	manhunt.admin
/manhunt teams	Open team management GUI	manhunt.admin
/manhunt reload	Reload plugin configuration	manhunt.admin

Team Management
Command	Description	Permission
/manhunt runner <player>	Set player as speedrunner	manhunt.admin
/manhunt hunter <player>	Add player to hunters team	manhunt.admin
/manhunt guard <player>	Add player to guards team	manhunt.admin
/manhunt spectator <player>	Add player to spectators team	manhunt.admin
/manhunt removeplayer <player>	Remove player from all teams	manhunt.admin
/manhunt clearteam <team>	Clear entire team	manhunt.admin
/manhunt listteams	Display all teams with members	manhunt.admin
Game Control

Command	Description	Permission
/manhunt headstart <seconds>	Set headstart time (0-300s)	manhunt.admin
/manhunt pause	Pause current game	manhunt.admin
/manhunt resume	Resume paused game	manhunt.admin
/manhunt setspawn <team>	Set spawn location for team	manhunt.admin
/manhunt stats	Show detailed game statistics	manhunt.admin
/manhunt scatter	Smart player positioning	manhunt.admin
/manhunt reset	Complete server reset	manhunt.admin
Advanced Features
Command	Description	Permission
/manhuntgui	Quick GUI access	manhunt.admin
/soulbound	Make held item soulbound	manhunt.admin
/reload	Reload EasyManhunt config	manhunt.admin
⚙️ Configuration
Enhanced Team Setup
speedrunner: 'PlayerName'
hunters:
  - 'Hunter1'
  - 'Hunter2'
guards:
  - 'Guard1'
spectators:
  - 'Spectator1'

 Advanced Armor System
speedrunnerArmor:
  helmet: DIAMOND_HELMET
  chestplate: DIAMOND_CHESTPLATE
  leggings: DIAMOND_LEGGINGS
  boots: DIAMOND_BOOTS
  enchantments:
    - "PROTECTION:2"
    - "UNBREAKING:3"

  Professional Compass Settings
compassUpdateInterval: 1
showDistance: true
maxTrackingDistance: 10000
hunterCircleRadius: 3
scatterRadius: 1000
Enhanced Features
hunterBoost: true
hunterBoostDuration: 60
speedrunnerGlow: true
teamChat: true
autoPause: true
  
🎯 Game Mechanics
Smart Scatter System
Speedrunner Placement - Center of safe location
Hunter Circle - Perfect circle around speedrunner (3 blocks)
Guard Positioning - Scattered within 10 blocks of center
Safety Checks - All locations verified for safety
Enhanced Headstart
Visual Freeze - Hunters get blindness and movement restrictions
Countdown System - Audio and visual countdown alerts
Hunter Boost - Speed and jump boost when headstart ends
Configurable Time - 0-300 seconds via command
Professional Tracking
Real-time Display - Distance shown above experience bar
Direction Indicators - Cardinal directions with live updates
Cross-dimension - Works in overworld, nether, and end
Winning Conditions
Hunters Win - Kill the speedrunner
Speedrunner Wins - Kill the Ender Dragon
Guards - Protect speedrunner from hunters
  
🔧 Technical Details
Compatibility
Minecraft: 1.16 - Latest versions
Server: Spigot, Paper, Purpur
Java: 8+
Performance
Lightweight and optimized
Minimal server impact
Efficient real-time tracking
Smart memory management
Professional sound effects
Advanced Features
Custom textured GUI heads
Action bar distance display
Lodestone compass tracking
Complete server reset system
Smart scatter positioning

📝 Usage Examples
Quick Game Setup
/manhunt runner Steve           # Set speedrunner
/manhunt hunter Alex            # Add hunters
/manhunt hunter Bob
/manhunt guard Charlie          # Add guards
/manhunt headstart 45           # Set 45s headstart
/manhunt scatter               # Position players
/manhunt start                 # Begin game!
Advanced Management
/manhunt setspawn hunter       # Set hunter spawn
/manhunt pause                 # Pause mid-game
/manhunt stats                 # Check game stats
/manhunt reset                 # Reset for new game
